summary: 10.0.38.11 DatePicker In-Field Desktop Parity Formatting & Label Cleanup
highlights: 1. In-Field Formatted Date Display: Formats dates directly inside the datepicker box (e.g. '21 Apr 2026') matching JavaFX Desktop DatePicker StringConverter.
2. Label Header Cleanup: Completely eliminated top [dd/MM/yyyy] format badges above date inputs for clean, uncluttered headers.
3. Duplicate Calendar Icon Elimination: Enhanced LabelIconEnhancer to detect existing emoji text and prevent double calendar icons (📅 📅 From Date).
4. Reactive Property Hooking: Intercepted input.value setter to synchronize in-field date display in real time during preset filtering (Today, 30 Days, This FY).
5. 100% ISO Compatibility: Retained standard ISO YYYY-MM-DD underlying value for zero regression on backend Spring Boot APIs and controller queries.
